name: Spring Ligament Injury
definition: Injury or degeneration of the plantar calcaneonavicular spring-ligament complex, often contributing to progressive collapsing flatfoot deformity.

investigations.principle: Weight-bearing radiographs assess deformity; MRI evaluates spring ligament and PTT.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, labral, tendon, cartilage, ligament or occult injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Progressive deformity may require reconstructive surgery.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada-Snayu/Sandhi support failure phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Injury or degeneration of the plantar calcaneonavicular spring-ligament complex, often contributing to progressive collapsing flatfoot deformity.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, unreduced dislocation, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
